answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in ferrous, verified in wharf, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ripple check. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
